name: framerhorizontalscroll
title: Framer Horizontal Scroll
blurb: Horizontal carousel triggered by vertical scroll, using Framer Motion to pan…
description: Full-page layout with a sticky carousel that scrolls horizontally as the user scrolls down the page. Images animate in sequence with whileInView states.
use_when: Immersive portfolio or case study galleries where horizontal panning adds visual impact.
avoid_when: Performance-sensitive pages or when horizontal scroll must work on mobile.
a11y: Images have alt text. Scroll-driven animation cannot be paused or skipped via keyboard.
